entries.appliesTo: persons making telephone campaign communications created using AI with the voice of a public figure

dutySources.disclosure-ui: R.S. 18:1463.1(D) — 'without providing a clear and understandable disclosure at the beginning of the call that it was created using artificial intelligence'

sources.disclosure: R.S. 18:1463.1(D) — 'No person shall make or cause to be made any telephone call or automated call provided for in this Section which is created using artificial intelligence, using the voice of a public figure, including an elected official or limited public figure, without providing a clear and understandable disclosure at the beginning of the call that it was created using artificial intelligence.'
sources.scope: R.S. 18:1463.1(D) — 'any telephone call or automated call provided for in this Section'; (E)(2) — '"Automated call" includes any call using a prerecorded or artificial voice as part of a calling campaign to deliver information.'
sources.penaltyMax: R.S. 18:1463.1(G) — 'Upon a second or subsequent violation, the penalty shall be a civil fine not to exceed five thousand dollars.'
sources.penaltyUnit: R.S. 18:1463.1(G) — 'Whoever violates any provision of this Section may be punished by a civil fine'; 'Upon a second or subsequent violation, the penalty shall be'
sources.enforcer: R.S. 18:1463.1(H) — 'The Board of Ethics shall administer and enforce the provisions of this Section.'

flags: Penalty is tiered: first violation civil fine max $2,500 (R.S. 18:1463.1(G) — 'a civil fine not to exceed two thousand five hundred dollars'); second or subsequent violation max $5,000; penaltyMax codes the higher tier per rule 11 (tier structure flagged, not encoded in penaltyUnit)

Duty is narrower than all AI calls: triggers only when the call is 'created using artificial intelligence, using the voice of a public figure, including an elected official or limited public figure' (§ D); no param exists for this voice-of-public-figure trigger
scope=robocalls is slightly lossy: § D covers 'any telephone call or automated call provided for in this Section', i.e. live telephone campaign calls as well as automated calls

Safe harbor: § F exempts from liability for content provided by another person interactive computer services (47 U.S.C. 230), ISPs/cloud/cybersecurity/information-service/telecommunications-service providers, and radio/TV broadcasters including cable/satellite operators, programmers, or producers
Section 2 amends R.S. 42:1132(D) to add R.S. 18:1463.1 to the Board of Ethics' jurisdiction — administrative conforming change, no additional company duty
'Artificial intelligence' is defined by cross-reference to R.S. 14:73.14 (§ E(1)); definition not imported per rule 4
